info.title: Mila Health, MIM API
info.description: Mila Health MIM API OpenAPI schema

get.description:
Health check endpoint.

Returns:
    dict: A dictionary containing the status of the service.

post.description:
Create an interaction based on the provided request.

Args:
    request (CreateInteractionRequest): The request object containing the details of the interaction.

Returns:
    CreateInteractionStatus: The status of the created interaction.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If any error occurs during the creation of the interaction.

get.description:
Retrieve the interaction response from the database.

Parameters:
interactionId (str): The ID of the interaction.

Returns:
InteractionResponse: The response of the interaction.

Raises:
HTTPException: If there is an error retrieving the interaction response from the database.

put.description:
Terminate the interaction.

Parameters:
interactionId (str): The ID of the interaction.

Returns:
InteractionResponse: The response of the interaction after termination.

Raises:
HTTPException: If there is an error retrieving the interaction response from the database.

post.description:
Handle the user response received during a chat interaction.

Args:
    request (Request): The incoming request object.

Returns:
    Response: The response object containing the interaction continuation response.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If there is an error during the interaction continuation process.
